notes: D1 oracle is the two official Skyss Rutetabeller PDFs (line 1, line 2), RE-FETCHED and re-transcribed directly this pass because the oracle report named them as D1 but did not itself transcribe the full ordered station arrays. Not generated from GTFS. Not generated from Entur Journey Planner / SIRI. Entur's geocoder was used only for NSR stop-place id + coordinate lookup after each D1 station name was locked from the PDFs — never for station order or count.

City id bergen is unused in existing packs. Display Bergen. Agency Skyss (Bybanen light rail only) — not Vy, not Skyss regional bus, not a merged Norway/city=norway feed. Country ledger docs/norway-ledger.md confirms Entur as the shared national feed but per-city adapters (no merged provider config).

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: Bybanen light rail lines 1 and 2 only, 33 unique stations (see H2 correction — NOT the oracle report's 35). No buses (out-mode, even where a Bybanen stop-place is co-located with a bus terminal — see coverageGaps), no Vy regional/long-distance rail (out of catalog by station-set definition, not a service-level verdict — Bergen Railway Station is never in this catalog).
Timezone Europe/Oslo HAS DST (CEST/CET) — corrects the oracle report's non-existent 'Europe/Bergen' IANA string (hazard-pack.md H7). Norway has exactly one IANA zone.

Two printed Bybanen lines: 1 Byparken - Bergen lufthavn (27 stations), 2 Bergen sentrum - Fyllingsdalen terminal (9 stations, station-level termini Kaigaten/Fyllingsdalen terminal). 33 unique stations total (27 + 9 - 3 shared: Nonneseter, Bergen busstasjon, Kronstad) — corrects the oracle report's claimed 27/10/35.

Locked hub: Bergen busstasjon (NOT Byparken, the oracle report's pick — see direction-model-memo.md for the full correction). Byparken and Kaigaten remain valid line-specific direction-chip termini; they are not shared by both lines (confirmed-distinct Entur NSR stop-places, ~150m apart) so neither can be the shared-reference hub string.

gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are the printed passenger line codes (1, 2) — the only codes Skyss prints. No stopIds/GTFS route ids looked up separately; the oracle report explicitly says D1 is hand-transcribed timetables, not GTFS-derived.

Feed / live (Jim D2, not a D1 generator): Entur Journey Planner v3 `stopPlace.estimatedCalls` GraphQL, POST https://api.entur.io/journey-planner/v3/graphql, header ET-Client-Name (NLOD open service, no key). Filter to authority SKY:Authority:SKY (Skyss) and transportMode tram. Entur SIRI ET/SX and GTFS-RT trip-updates/alerts also available per datasetId=SKY; no SIRI VM / vehicle-positions confirmed for light rail in the country ledger. Static Entur GTFS is NOT a D1 generator. D1 stays planned. assertCityLive("bergen") must fail. Full detail in jim-handoff.md.

License: NLOD 2.0 per the oracle report and the country ledger. Attribution required (name Entur and Skyss), commercial reuse permitted, ET-Client-Name header is mandatory identification, not a secret. Not re-verified in this pass — the oracle report's/ledger's license tables are treated as settled.
coverageGaps: Skyss regional bus (out-mode, even at Bybanen stop-places that are also bus stops/terminals — Bergen busstasjon, Nygård, Florida, Danmarks plass, Wergeland, Slettebakken, Nesttun terminal/sentrum, Skjoldskiftet, Mårdalen, Fyllingsdalen terminal, Lagunen terminal, Birkelandsskiftet terminal, Bergen lufthavn all show a co-located bus tag in Entur's stop-place register — mode cut applies regardless).

Vy Bergensbanen (Oslo-Bergen long-distance) and Vy Arna line (local) at Bergen Railway Station: out of catalog by station-set definition, not a service-level verdict. Bergen stasjon (NSR:StopPlace:59983) is never an in-catalog Bybanen stop-place — closest is Nonneseter (~90m) or Bergen busstasjon (~350m), both confirmed-distinct stop-places. No verdict owed per docs/board-eligibility-rule.md and docs/norway-ledger.md.

Åsane extension (13 future stations: Torget, Sandbrogaten, Sandviken kirke, Amalie Skrams vei, Sandviken sykehus, NHH, Eidsvåg, Tertneskrysset, Åsane terminal, Åsane Sentrum, Nyborg, Langarinden, Vågsbotn): all 'TBD' opening dates per Wikipedia's own Future table. Not on either current Skyss PDF. Not inserted.
No passenger line 3 or higher. Two lines only.
